# The ReAct Loop {#sec-the-react-loop}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "the agent thinks" — it reasons in text, acts through your
functions, observes the results, and repeats; a loop you can read.

Installs: reason → act → observe, the `hands_on_ai.agent` trace,
stopping conditions. Working build: a small agent with two or three
tools whose full thought process prints as it works.
:::
